title: Review surface header fix: before/after at desktop, tablet and phone
summary: The document review page pins only a slim bar; the brief scrolls away, folded to the ask. Before/after of the Joey and Meeple Magnate status report package at desktop 100%, 125% and 150%, 768px and 375px. QA round 1: every control on the page, in the viewers, the full-screen lightbox, the navigator and the review drawer is now at least 44x44px on tablets and phones (77 and 78 undersized controls before, 0 after, across 14 page states).
